name: Stare Aparaty
description: Polish-language catalog of second-hand analog (film) cameras sold by the site owner, plus hand-picked film stocks and developing/scanning gear. The camera catalog is rebuilt daily from the owner's live OLX listings; every entry carries title, price, availability and a direct purchase link.

skills.name: Analog camera catalog
skills.description: GET /olx_meta.json returns every listed camera as {id, title, image, url, host, sold, price, oldPrice}. Prices are in PLN; `sold: true` means the listing is no longer available. Rebuilt daily.
examples: What analog cameras are currently for sale?
Which cameras are under 400 PLN and still available?

skills.name: Film stock and developing gear prices
skills.description: GET /amazon-products.json (keyed by Amazon ASIN) and /allegro-products.json (keyed by slug) return {label, price in PLN, lastChecked} for the recommended film stocks and developing/scanning equipment.
examples: What black-and-white film does this site recommend and what does it cost?

_note: This is a published data source, not a callable JSON-RPC agent: the skills above describe static JSON documents to fetch, and no transport accepts A2A messages. Declared here so an agent can find the machine-readable catalog without scraping the HTML.
